policy.separation: The raw diagnostic report remains unchanged and retains every heuristic warning. This companion view filters only fingerprint-current reviewed-no-revision decisions from the actionable queue.
policy.staleReview: A changed prompt, key, answer position, diagnostic family, or duplicate-pair fingerprint automatically returns the item to the action docket.
policy.limitation: Docket priority is editorial triage, not psychometric severity, item-response analysis, or independent expert validation.
